name: The Guide to the Temple
summary: Since the Tsolenka gate opened, a man has led three parties up the goat path toward the Amber Temple and come down alone each time.

stages.journal: The dead sergeant at the Tsolenka watchtower has logged lanterns on the goat path round his tower: three parties this winter, and one lantern coming down each time. Last night a man, a woman, and a sledge with something small on it, coughing, and a guide in front who walks like he's never cold.
objectives: Follow the goat path from the Tsolenka Pass toward the Amber Temple
Find the party with the sledge
stages.hint: Take the goat path from the Tsolenka Pass toward the Amber Temple, and find the camp with the sledge.

stages.journal: The guide had been keeping the child sick with sleep-root in her tea, to make her parents climb. Something in the amber paid him a year for every family. We stopped him.
objectives: Talk to Floarea at the camp
stages.hint: Talk to Floarea by the sledge at the camp on the goat path.

stages.journal: Without the tea the little girl will wake in a day or two, with only a cough to carry home. Remus and Floarea are taking her down.
